testcase.name: blank and no-change commits never create history
staging paths cannot escape into metadata or another folder
staged content remains visible when the working tree matches HEAD again
stage all includes added modified and deleted files but respects ignores
binary and pure rename paths retain exact metadata without patch-header guesses
staged deletion and recreated working file stay separate

staged and unstaged versions are separate and local commit preserves the later edits
status counts partial paths once and includes both unstaged and staged deletions
stage and unstage rename update both paths
